[SWS_CM_80509] Only field notifier support for
Signal-Based Static
network
binding
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
The
Signal-Based Static
network binding only supports the field notifier. Getter
or Setter methods are not supported.
⌋
7.2.2.2.6 Serialization of Payload
In case of the static signal-service-translation always the signal-service-translation is
responsible for the handling of the serialization.
